rules.statement: Where the provisions of section 16 of the Mortgage Act are not applicable to a person who seeks to intervene in a mortgage action as a party having an interest in it, the Court must consider whether he is entitled to intervene and be added as a party on the basis of section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code or on any other ground or principle of law.
